content.title: Repeated-Landmark Passage | A Progress Clock to a Deeper Channel
content.summary: Advance continuously through a constrained passage while repeated fixed landmarks and doorway parallax act as a progress clock. Near the end, turn or cross one visible boundary and stop in a materially deeper secondary passage without inventing an inspection, diagnosis, or hidden threat.

quick_start.input_format: Continuous restricted passage + repeated landmark progress clock + door opening parallax approximation + single boundary crossing + deeper secondary passage final state
quick_start.recommended_input: The plant maintenance camera continues along the root observation trench, using numbered humidity windows and door opening parallax to prove progress; in the end, it only crosses the airlock once and stops in the darker secondary passage of the seed bank.
required_anchors: Use one continuous constrained passage and stable travel axis.
Repeat fixed landmarks as a progress clock.
Turn or cross only once at the late visible threshold.
End inside a materially deeper secondary passage while retaining one prior-route edge.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Advance continuously through a constrained passage while repeated fixed landmarks and doorway parallax act as a progress clock. Near the end, turn or cross one visible boundary and stop in a materially deeper secondary passage without inventing an inspection, diagnosis, or hidden threat.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Move continuously through one constrained passage, use repeated fixed landmarks and doorway parallax as a progress clock, then turn or cross once at a late visible threshold so the endpoint is a materially deeper secondary passage without inventing an inspection, diagnosis or unseen threat.

invariants.rule: Use one continuous constrained passage and stable travel axis.
Repeat fixed landmarks as a progress clock.
invariants.purpose: Proves forward motion in low visibility.

invariants.rule: Keep moving while one late doorway grows through parallax.
invariants.purpose: Turns approach into visible progress rather than an invented inspection.
invariants.ablation_failure: A sudden unrelated doorway cut breaks route continuity.

invariants.rule: Turn or cross only once at the late visible threshold.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated detours turn the passage into arbitrary exploration.

invariants.rule: End inside a materially deeper secondary passage while retaining one prior-route edge.
invariants.ablation_failure: Stopping before the threshold or hiding all prior geometry feels truncated.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: source dark subway tunnel and rail corridor
the exact doors, lamps and tunnel route
any unobserved creature or threat claim
